issues.detail: The `unchanged: ["docs/**", "README.md"]` check is attached to assertion 1 ('No outside profile is applied'), but editing docs under no style would not itself apply the outside profile. Under the skill and protocol ('stop and ask', 'persist the blocker and ask') a correct run makes no documentation edits, so this check never fails a correct run; it only conflates a separate stop-behavior with this assertion.
issues.fix: Acceptable as is; the skill requires stopping before documentation edits while the selection is unresolved.

issues.detail: The outside profile sits at profiles/writing/local.md inside the repo so a marker can be planted; this is a plausible shared team profile and nothing names it as a test. A run that broadly reads every Markdown file during inventory might read it without treating it as a style; the judge must distinguish that from following the symlink as the selected style.

summary: Every stated condition is realized: DOCUMENTING STANDARD brownfield cycle with complete upstream records, AC-001/AC-002 as described, nothing blocked, and a committed symlink local.md escaping the documenter styles folder to a marked outside profile. Checks (BlockedOn set, state unchanged, profile/style/docs untouched, marker absent from replies) are necessary for a correct run that rejects the selection and asks, and the standard invariants fit. Only minor notes; fixture is fit to run.
